So can i answer me this question quickly plz?? (2) Also Shall I talk with him when he request to my mum to talk with me only once ??? Because we r very far from each other so can i talk with him only one time in front of my mum?? Answer ID: 27551 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim !
